## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Required review

- [ ] I disclosed whether scientific results changed.
- [ ] Frozen inputs changed, or I confirmed they did not.
- [ ] Reference outputs changed, or I confirmed they did not.
- [ ] Computation-affecting configuration changed, or I confirmed it did not.
- [ ] Citations changed, or I confirmed they did not.
- [ ] Data redistribution status changed, or I confirmed it did not.
- [ ] Tests passed.
- [ ] Smoke passed.
- [ ] Verify passed, or the external-input limitation is documented.
- [ ] The documentation audit passed.
- [ ] Protected-tree hashes were reviewed.
- [ ] No credential, private path, restricted input, manuscript, or correspondence is included.
